summary: A low-level Mazchna and Vannaka task fought just west of Canifis in Morytania. Ghouls hit up to 5 with crush, are aggressive, and run away when their hitpoints get low, so ranged or magic from behind the gravestones (or poison) is the easiest way to secure kills; melee works but expect them to flee. They look undead but are alive, so the salve amulet and Crumble Undead do nothing. Both the Salve graveyard north of Mort Myre and the grounds south of the Slayer Tower have about a dozen spawns each, and a ghoul may randomly attack players under combat level 85.
styleNotes: Not undead despite appearances, so immune to Crumble Undead and the salve amulet; retreat at low hitpoints, so poison or ranged/magic helps finish kills; no poison, venom or cannon immunity in the infobox.
usefulItems: Poisoned weapon or ammo (kills fleeing ghouls)

summary: A level 70+ combat task from Krystilia, Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve and Duradel. Greater demons only melee, so Protect from Melee or a safespot handles them; demonbane weapons (Arclight, Emberlight) shred them and they have a 40% water weakness. The Chasm of Fire is the usual spot because it is compact and cannonable (single-way), while the Catacombs of Kourend are multicombat for AFK burst/venator killing plus ancient shard and dark totem drops. Wilderness tasks are best done in the Wilderness Slayer Cave, which is both multi and cannonable but heavily PKed.

summary: A 51 Slayer task on the Great Conch (Troubled Tortugans and 45 Sailing) from Vannaka, Chaeldar and Mortimer, or Nieve/Duradel after buying Wings Spread. Gryphons melee and have a knockback special that hurts if your equipped weight is under 30 kg, so wear heavy gear; they are weakest to stab melee and 50% weak to air spells. The best method is the south-western multicombat room of the eastern task-only cave with a cannon and a venator bow or melee; the western cave has a full safespot. A tortugan shield is only required for the dire gryphon superior and the Shellbane gryphon boss.

summary: A mid-to-high level task from Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve, Duradel and Krystilia. Hellhounds only bite with accurate melee, so either safespot them (they are 2x2 and get stuck on rocks) or keep Protect from Melee on; they are demons, so Arclight/Emberlight work well. The Stronghold Slayer Cave is the standard spot (four rooms, task-only, cannon allowed), the Catacombs of Kourend are multicombat for AFK venator bow or burst plus ancient shard and totem drops, and Wilderness tasks are done in the Wilderness Slayer Cave. Their draw is the 1/64 hard clue rate (1/32 with an imbued ring of wealth in the Wilderness).
styleNotes: Demonic, so weak to demonbane weapons; 50% water spell weakness; melee (stab) only, so Protect from Melee negates everything; no poison, venom, cannon or thrall immunity.
usefulItems: Dwarf multicannon (Stronghold Slayer Cave, Taverley, Karuulm, Wilderness Slayer Cave)

summary: A 95 Slayer task from Konar and Mortimer, found only on the lower level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon. Hydras alternate ranged and magic in sets of one to three attacks and later spit poison pools, so start with the protection prayer for your weaker defence and swap when they switch; ranged (twisted bow) or a dragonbane weapon is standard because of their very high magic level. Wear boots of stone, brimstone or granite unless you have the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary. The Alchemical Hydra boss can be killed instead while on task and is far more profitable.
styleNotes: Draconic: weak to dragonbane weapons and 40% weak to earth spells; 160 stab, slash, crush and magic defence but 0 light, standard and heavy ranged defence; attacks with magic and ranged and spits poison; poison and venom resistance 0 in the infobox.
requiredItems: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary)
usefulItems: Dragon hunter crossbow / dragon hunter lance (dragonbane)

summary: A Turael and Spria beginner task (20 combat) of only 15-20 kills. Icefiends are level 13 demons that hit 2 with magical melee and are weak to fire spells, so anything kills them.
